name: Animate Plants, Hasty
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 7, shaman 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 sswift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets one Large plant per three caster levels
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as animate plants, except as noted above and in that it cannot emulate an entangle spell.
